name: Illusion
description: Reality is obscured; perception may be unreliable.
general_template: Something may not be as clear as it appears. Look twice before trusting the first interpretation.
love_template: A connection may be shaped by assumptions, projections, or things left unsaid.
career_template: Do not act on an impression before checking the facts behind it.
self_template: Your intuition is active, but fear or imagination may be mixing with what you know.
choice_template: Separate what you know from what you fear before choosing.
unknown_template: The full picture is hidden for now. Let more information surface.

name: Obsession
description: A healthy desire becomes fixation or overattachment.
general_template: Something that matters to you may be taking up more space than it should.
love_template: Hope or attraction can become fixation when you hold too tightly to a desired outcome.
career_template: Ambition may become unhealthy when your identity depends on one result.
self_template: One desire may be gaining more power over you than it deserves.
choice_template: Be careful not to let one preferred outcome make the decision for you.
unknown_template: Something may be holding more power over you than you realize.

name: Attachment
description: Connection becomes difficulty releasing what has already changed.
general_template: You may be carrying something forward simply because it is familiar.
love_template: A bond may be difficult to release even when the relationship has changed.
career_template: A past role, goal, or expectation may be keeping you from adapting.
self_template: You may be defining yourself through something you have already outgrown.
choice_template: Ask whether you are choosing this path or simply refusing to let another one go.
unknown_template: Something from the past still has a hold on the present.

name: Suppression
description: Something important is being hidden, denied, or silenced.
general_template: An important truth may be pushed aside because acknowledging it would require change.
love_template: Feelings may be present but deliberately left unspoken.
career_template: A concern or disagreement may be going unaddressed.
self_template: You may already know something you are not ready to admit.
choice_template: Notice what you are avoiding saying or acknowledging before you decide.
unknown_template: Something wants to be acknowledged, but it has not found a voice yet.

name: Manipulation
description: Agency or influence becomes control over self or others.
general_template: A desire to control the outcome may be replacing trust or honest communication.
love_template: Influence can become control when fear of losing the connection takes over.
career_template: Power dynamics or pressure may be affecting the decision more than the work itself.
self_template: You may be trying to control something that cannot be controlled.
choice_template: Ask whether the choice is genuinely yours or being shaped by pressure.
unknown_template: Someone or something may be influencing the situation more strongly than it appears.

name: Stagnation
description: Energy that should move becomes stuck.
general_template: Waiting has become a pattern rather than a temporary pause.
love_template: A connection may remain unchanged because neither side is willing to move.
career_template: Preparation can become endless delay if action never follows.
self_template: You may be mistaking comfort for progress.
choice_template: Do not confuse avoiding movement with making a careful decision.
unknown_template: The situation is not moving because something is keeping it in place.

name: Recklessness
description: Courage or freedom becomes impulsive behavior.
general_template: The desire to escape limitations may be pushing you to act before thinking.
love_template: Excitement may be encouraging choices without enough consideration for consequences.
career_template: Taking a risk can become dangerous when preparation is skipped.
self_template: Freedom without awareness can become self-sabotage.
choice_template: Do not let the desire for immediate change replace judgment.
unknown_template: Movement is possible, but acting too quickly may create a problem of its own.

name: Isolation
description: Solitude becomes disconnection from others or from yourself.
general_template: Distance that once helped you reflect may now be preventing connection.
love_template: Protecting yourself may have become a reason to avoid intimacy.
career_template: Working alone may be limiting the support or perspective you need.
self_template: Self-reflection can become disconnection when no outside perspective is allowed in.
choice_template: Consider whether independence is helping you choose or simply keeping others out.
unknown_template: You may be standing apart from something that could offer perspective or support.

name: Decay
description: Something once healthy is losing vitality through neglect.
general_template: Something is weakening because it has been left unattended for too long.
love_template: A connection may be losing vitality because an important need has been neglected.
career_template: A stable situation may deteriorate if maintenance and attention stop.
self_template: A part of your life may need care before neglect becomes harder to reverse.
choice_template: Consider what could quietly deteriorate if you keep postponing action.
unknown_template: Something is losing energy beneath the surface and needs attention.

name: Fear
description: Awareness becomes avoidance, paralysis, or defensive behavior.
general_template: A warning may be useful, but fear can also make every possibility look dangerous.
love_template: Fear of rejection or loss may be shaping the way you interpret the connection.
career_template: Fear of failure may be making a necessary risk feel impossible.
self_template: You may be protecting yourself from an outcome that has not happened.
choice_template: Do not let fear make the decision before you have examined the actual risk.
unknown_template: Uncertainty is activating fear. Notice the difference between a warning and an assumption.
